job.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
job.description:
Revenue Operations Analyst
ExampleCloud is hiring a Revenue Operations Analyst to improve pipeline visibility and reporting across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success. The role will own recurring pipeline and funnel reporting, partner with stakeholders on metric definitions, and improve trust in CRM data.
Responsibilities include analyzing lead lifecycle conversion and sales handoffs, identifying routing and follow-up gaps, building dashboards for revenue leadership, and automating manual reporting workflows. The analyst will work with CRM data, SQL, BI tools, and data warehouse models.
The ideal candidate can translate analysis into operational recommendations, work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Systems teams, and communicate findings to leadership. Experience with Salesforce is preferred.
Success in the first six months includes more reliable pipeline reporting, faster identification of funnel issues, clearer ownership of revenue metrics, and reduced manual reporting work.
Compensation: $105,000-$130,000 base.

resume.label: Revenue Operations Analyst
resume.text:
Jordan Lee
Professional Summary
Revenue Operations Analyst using SQL, Python, Power BI, BigQuery, dbt, and HubSpot to diagnose funnel and pipeline performance, automate reporting, and improve GTM processes.
Work History
Revenue Operations Analyst, BrightArc SaaS, 2022-Present
Analyzed lead lifecycle and routing data to identify handoff delays and inconsistent ownership; implemented SLA monitoring and routing alerts that reduced SLA breaches from 31% to 12%.
Built dbt models in BigQuery and Power BI dashboards for pipeline, funnel, and retention reporting; replaced manual spreadsheet reporting and saved approximately 8 hours per week.
Analyzed channel attribution and campaign performance to guide reallocation of $120K in quarterly media spend; qualified sales opportunities increased 18% in the following quarter.
Partnered with Sales, Marketing, and Finance to standardize revenue metric definitions and create an executive KPI review used in weekly operating meetings.
Audited CRM data quality and automated validation checks for missing lifecycle stages and ownership fields, reducing recurring reporting cleanup.
Project: Revenue Pipeline Diagnostic
Modeled leads, accounts, opportunities, and activities in PostgreSQL and created SQL views for MQL conversion, first-touch SLA, routing, follow-up, and pipeline ARR. Identified a 26% SLA breach rate and $410K in unattributed pipeline, then recommended matching, alerting, and data hygiene improvements.
Skills
Revenue Analytics: pipeline, funnel, MQL, SLA, lifecycle, attribution, routing
BI: SQL, Excel, Power BI, Looker Studio
Data: Python, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, dbt, ELT, data modeling
Systems: HubSpot, CRM integrations, APIs, workflow automation
Education
BS Applied Mathematics
